summary: Iteration 4 testing: Chiavi nav+page, key_boxes A/B/C persistence, section=access deep-link, structures list overhaul (no Apri), Foto/Video/Altro single-category media, Client logo upload/remove, Settings 'Google Fogli' graceful degradation, and sheets_sync._build_tabs 9-tab structure with sensitive-code exclusion. 9/9 backend tests pass; frontend flows all verified via Playwright with only one minor testid naming inconsistency.

ui_bugs.issue: Stat card testids use lowercase (stat-box-a/b/c) but review spec calls them stat-box-A/B/C. Elements exist and work; only the naming differs.

action_items: Optional: rename stat-box-a/b/c → stat-box-A/B/C in KeysPage.js to match spec (line 75-77).
critical_code_review_comments: services/sheets_sync.py hardcodes SPREADSHEET title formatting details; _build_tabs reads 3000 clients/structures/users into memory — acceptable at current scale but should be paged for larger tenants.

server.py client-logo endpoint (line 606) infers extension from filename but does not sanitize; a filename like '../..%2Ftest.png' won't reach the FS (put_object treats path as opaque key) but keeping file extension whitelist ({png,jpg,jpeg,webp,gif}) would be safer.
The delete_client_logo endpoint does not remove the object from storage — only clears logo_path in DB. Orphaned files will accumulate. Consider calling delete_object(old path) before/after DB update.
server.py is still very large (>6000 lines) — recommendation from previous iterations still applies.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows; 1 minor testid naming note)

seed_data_creation: Backend test creates a temp client 'TESTLOGO User' via POST /api/clients, uploads/deletes its logo, then DELETEs the client (fixture teardown). key_boxes on KLV-0002 are mutated during test then restored to the original access_info snapshot. Frontend Playwright uploaded a 1x1 PNG to Pulizie SRL's logo (replaced main-agent's smoke logo with a tinier one — cosmetic only, visible as small dot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_features.py (pytest). It loads /app/backend/.env (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME) so it can import services.sheets_sync and directly call _build_tabs() to assert the 9 tab titles + verify sensitive codes (1234/5678 for KLV-0002) never appear in Strutture/Chiavi rows. Google Sheets is intentionally NOT configured — do NOT try to configure it; status endpoint returns configured=false with both env vars in missing[] and sync returns 400 with Italian message 'Google Fogli non configurato'. Client logo endpoints accept only image/* content-types (400 for non-image). Frontend testid stat-box-a/b/c is lowercase.
